title: Understanding Cross Validation
text: In 8-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into $$8$$ parts. Each part is used once as a validation set while the remaining $$7$$ parts form the training set.

title: Regularization Hyperparameter
text: The regularization hyperparameter is a value that controls the amount of regularization applied to the model. In this problem, we are testing $$11$$ different values of this hyperparameter.

title: Calculating the Number of Training Sets
text: For each value of the hyperparameter, we perform 8-fold cross-validation. This means we train the model $$8$$ times for each hyperparameter value.

title: Determine the Total Number of Training Sets
text: How many times is the model trained in total when using 8-fold cross-validation for $$11$$ hyperparameter values?

title: Understanding the Formula
text: The formula $$11\left(8-1\right)$$ represents the number of times each data point is used in the training dataset across all hyperparameter values.
